class.name: double_arm_hardware/ArmSystemHardware
class.description: JAKA dual-arm SystemInterface plugin. Supports dry-run (no hardware) and real Modbus+serial modes. Each URDF ros2_control instance configures one arm (left or right).

class.name: double_arm_hardware/Stm32SystemHardware
class.description: Whole-robot SystemInterface for the AIMotor_F407 STM32 (V1.3.1). One instance exports all 12 joints (L_J1..L_J6, R_J1..R_J6) and talks to one serial device with the binary whole-robot protocol. on_configure is READ-ONLY (open + HELLO + GET_STATE, no enable); on_activate waits for valid_bitmap == 0x0FFF, syncs command to feedback, runs ENABLE, verifies enabled == 0x0FFF, then opens the target gate.
